experiment.display_name: S3 稳定接收机几何多解耦三种子 E40
experiment.description: 原始匹配E200 CE旧门控cos父权重上续训40轮；保留L/T，只替换为跨TX跨日稳定RX R，复用固定B0/B2/B3对照。
experiment.authorization: 用户要求按最新设计报告继续追求目标；源域条件可预测性与源V身份保持检查均通过后，发布保守R变体三种子E40，4进程/GPU，自动clean。

code.commit_note: Preregistration baseline; exact execution commit inserted from immutable release at launch

data.representation: equalized=1; center crop/pad 256; per-packet complex RMS; center=False; fs=25MHz

roles.U_use: index-only exact role audit; no U sample/label/training iterator

data.split_id: inherited deterministic physical source roles (historical protocol label 392005)
data.support_query_ref: No support adaptation; target query capsule only after source freeze
data.train_ratio_definition: rho_label=L_s/(L_s+U_s)=0.1; only L_s contributes to training
data.diagnostic_access: L_s6300拟合/审计；V27000只读验证和固定L拟合读出；U_s不读取；target仅主训练冻结后clean预测与truth-last评分

permissions.query_use: fixed independent per-packet prediction after final checkpoint freeze
permissions.claim_scope: S3 fixed three-seed clean mean >=84%; matched fixed existing B0/B2/B3 controls; descriptive paired differences

checkpoint.initialization: same-seed ORIGINAL E200 pure CE; strict provenance; fresh AdamW; never initialize from B/C/S fine-tuned weights

sources.initialization: scratch at origin; no upstream checkpoint
sources.selection: fixed final E200; no target selection
sources.actual_training: L_s clean CE only; no U/EMA/pseudo/satellite; smoothing=0

sources.initialization: scratch at origin; no upstream checkpoint
sources.selection: fixed final E200; no target selection
sources.actual_training: L_s clean CE only; no U/EMA/pseudo/satellite; smoothing=0

sources.initialization: scratch at origin; no upstream checkpoint
sources.selection: fixed final E200; no target selection
sources.actual_training: L_s clean CE only; no U/EMA/pseudo/satellite; smoothing=0

checkpoint.provenance_verdict: SOURCE_AUDIT_VERIFIED; runtime rechecks actual parent files and exact physical roles before use
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final E40 per row, no early stop or target selection; controls reused unchanged

execution.gpu_policy: max4 total processes/GPU including existing, shared lock, 12000 MB minimum free; no healthy job intervention
execution.stop_rule: technical failure retained; no automatic retry or overwrite

rows.purpose: S3 stable cross-TX/day RX full160 constraint
rows.seed_notes: Matched original parent model seed; fixed physical source roles (protocol392005, no resplit); ordinary RNG=model+101; relation RNG=model+202; actions use model+13*global_identity_step; clean deterministic evaluation; no support. Preparation uses separately recorded private seed offsets.
rows.budget_ref: 40epoch ×222=8880 identity updates; auxiliary every4, R every8, max32; cached preparation shared per seed

Preparation uses separately recorded private seed offsets.

notes: 原始纯CE父权重为唯一初始化；前轮C0/C1/C2/C3不作为新权重。
源审计是同一6300物理L_s样本分别观察三份父权重，不能算18900独立样本。
不增加unbounded增强CE、默认Fishr、额外身份骨干、交互网络、在线刷新或未验证物理特征支路。
单向有限margin=log95；weights keep=.1/LT=1/R=1；ramp444；无CE梯度比例校准。
源读出只在L_s拟合，V只读；无target反馈；未达目标不得报告成功。

test_completion_plan.checkpoint_selection: final E40 only; no early selection

physical_actions.objective: maximize fixed-parent true-IQ logit-margin drop; fixed classifier scale 30

temporal.phase_process: three smooth sine modes; clipped Gaussian coefficients

fractional_delay.operator: zero-pad 256 each side, FFT phase shift, crop original central 256
fractional_delay.zero_delay: exact value identity with differentiable delay path
fractional_delay.boundary_assumption: IQ outside observed 256-sample window is zero; sinc interpolation may ring near truncated edges
fractional_delay.scope: new fixed mild timing perturbation, not satellite/channel simulation or calibrated source error

physical_actions.random: explicit private CPU generators; no global RNG consumption

reused_controls.scope: fixed E40/8880 from same original E200 parents; no new training; reused predictions verified and independently rescored after new predictions freeze
reused_controls.rationale: B0 same budget CE; B2 conditional L/T without R; B3 only R estimator differs. All fixed before new target access.
